description_en: Updates information for a specified experiment group, such as its name and description
description_zh: 更新指定实验组的信息，例如更新实验组的名称、描述
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice update-experiment-group --experiment-group-id 3 --layer-id 3 --name experiment_group1 --description This_is_a_test. --debug-users user1,user2,user3 --debug-crowd-id 3 --need-aa true --filter gender=male --crowd-id 3 --distribution-type UserId --distribution-time-duration 3 --config RankBy_:_Score --reservced-buckets 1,2,3 --instance-id pairec-cn-abcdefg1234 --crowd-target-type All --random-flow 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateExperimentGroup

parameters.description_en:
The type of crowd targeting for the experiment group. Valid values:

- All: all traffic

- Filter: traffic that matches the filter condition

- CrowdId: traffic from the specified crowd ID

- Random: a random percentage of traffic
parameters.description_zh:
实验组流量定向的类型，可能的取值包括：
* All  所有的流量
* Filter 使用过滤条件的流量
* CrowdId 通过指定人群ID
* Random 按照百分比随机流量
